description: A document whose schema version is newer than the server understands.

nodes.text: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.

derivation: document doc-1: CLOUD_SCHEMA_UPDATE_REQUIRED -> the document has no value; it propagates
-> CLOUD_SCHEMA_UPDATE_REQUIRED: the workspace component has no value
account: CLOUD_SCHEMA_UPDATE_REQUIRED propagates from an unknown workspace; the aggregate has no value
notes: koru_projection::worker checks WorkspaceDoc::compatibility() before walking and, on Compatibility::TooNew, marks the document and returns without projecting. A document the server cannot fully interpret has fields it cannot see — including, possibly, a new kind of text — so any number it produced would be an under-count.
A separate code from USAGE_UNKNOWN because the remedy differs: deploy a Cloud that understands the schema. Nothing about the customer's document is wrong.
The deployment-ordering rule exists so this state is not reachable in production: Cloud understands a schema version in every region before any client that can write it is released.
